criteria: Fixed-Q l=0 lowest eigenvalue positive and convergent; l=1 translation and l=0 phase approach zero as O(dr^2); l=2 positive. Inspect all residuals. Angular operator ordering extends l>=2 and l>=1 phase sectors. No claim of computer-assisted rigorous spectral enclosure.
mathematics: Hminus_l=-d_r^2+l(l+1)/r^2+S^2+b F^2-Omega^2; Hplus_l diagonals add 2bF^2 and a(3S^2-1)+F^2, off-diagonal 2SF. Fixed Q adds 4Omega^2 |rF><rF| / integral(r^2F^2 dr) to l=0 amplitude block.
posthoc_scope: Additive diagnostic proposed after coarse/medium finite runs; no empirical target fitted. Profile and exact symmetry modes predate these runs.
